September 2026 Exchange Website Traffic Report: MoM increased 11.41%, with OKX traffic rising sharply in the US and Singapore WuBlockchain data shows that total website traffic across 12 major crypto exchanges rose 11.41% MoM to 150.73 million visits in September 2026, with 9 exchanges recording increases and 3 declines. Binance ranked first with 34.66 million visits (23.0%), followed by OKX at 33.23 million (22.0%) and Coinbase at 22.65 million (15.0%). The three accounted for 60.1% of total traffic. Deribit recorded the largest MoM increase (+56.6%), followed by OKX (+29.7%) and Bybit (+12.7%), while CryptoCom saw the largest decline (-3.1%). Korea was Binance’s largest traffic source, while the US ranked first for both OKX and Coinbase. — link

Binance US Seeks Up to $100M at $1B Valuation to Expand US Business, Considers Tapping Binance Global Liquidity Bloomberg reported that Binance US is seeking to raise up to $100 million in a private funding round at a target valuation of approximately $1 billion to expand its US operations. World Liberty Financial, a crypto venture linked to the Trump family, was made aware of the fundraising but is not participating. Binance US previously raised over $200 million in 2022 at a $4.5 billion pre-money valuation but lost significant market share following Binance's 2023 settlement with US authorities. The exchange is now exploring expansion into prediction markets, seeking to restore certain state money transmitter licenses, and considering external sources of trading liquidity, potentially including Binance's global exchange, though no final decision has been made. — link

Chainalysis: Task Scammer Loses Over 60 BTC Worth $4.8M in Ledger Wallet Theft Chainalysis said that one of the largest victims of a recent theft involving Ledger wallets was a scammer who lost over 60 BTC, worth approximately $4.8 million. The funds originated from a task scam in which people were paid to generate fake sales and reviews for real products, then told to deposit their own money after a negative balance appeared in order to receive payment. On September 22, the scammer transferred the proceeds to three separate Ledger addresses. On October 9, thieves drained all three addresses through one transaction each, sending the funds to the same wallet, which has been flagged as associated with stolen funds. — link

MSCI Adopts New Index Exclusion Rules; Strategy and Metaplanet Face Potential Removal MSCI has adopted new rules to exclude non-operating companies from its Global Investable Market Indexes. In an earlier simulation based on May 2026 data, MSCI identified Bitcoin treasury companies Strategy (MSTR) and Metaplanet (3350) as potential removals, while Ethereum treasury company SharpLink (SBET) would be placed on a watchlist. The final list of affected constituents will be published on November 11. The new rules, effective after the November 30 close, will exclude companies that fail an operating-assets test and trigger at least four of five financial exclusion criteria. Existing constituents must fail the screening in both of their two most recent annual filing periods before removal. MSCI will also lift temporary index restrictions on companies previously identified as holding digital assets worth at least 50% of total assets, assessing them under the new methodology instead. — link
